Square Yards initially committed a "pass back" incentive to encourage me to purchase through their platform. However, after the transaction was completed, they failed to honor this commitment—despite multiple follow-ups. This practice, in my view, is misleading and erodes buyer trust.

Beyond the initial promise, I found no meaningful value addition from Square Yards in the transaction process. Their involvement did not enhance the deal, simplify documentation, or offer post-sale support.
